snippet.title: FROGBLOCK - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hop into 100+ beautiful Perspective-Block-Puzzle levels as a tiny Frog in FROGBLOCK, a premium indie puzzle game!

Change your perspective to find illusory paths, and create your own paths by moving Frogblocks around!

Explore biomes and discover new mechanics while listening to a rich and calming original soundtrack!

Download links and game community info:

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4079420/FROGBLOCK/
App Store:
